messages:
Sam: Thanks for joining the all-hands — opening this thread for the Qs we ran out of time on and to capture owners/links. Recording + slides: https://redwood.ai/allhands/sep-2026 :wave:
Yara: Quick confirmation: will the GA rollout include auto-rollback on quality regressions or just alerting? Customers want specifics.
Diego: Plan is alert + automatic throttle for the first canary phase, auto-rollback only if sentinel metrics hit critical thresholds. Will draft the exact thresholds and post here. Owner: @Diego (EOW).
Clare: Docs ask: we need a short migration checklist for customers moving from hosted -> dedicated (keys, routing, quotas, monitoring). I can write a first draft.
Ben: Please include a snippet for updating SDK endpoints and auth header example. I'll review for accuracy.
Yara: Also: what's the official policy for deprecating old quant profiles? Sales asked about contract language.
Sam: Default deprecation notice = 60 days for non-breaking profile changes; 90 days if behavior changes might impact quality. Ben to confirm legal wording.
Diego: Infra note: we're enabling per-tenant logging fold at canary. infra-bot will post deployments into this thread while we run the rollout.
infra-bot: Canary deployed to staging-us-west at 2026-09-14T13:22:00Z. Monitoring hooks active.
Clare: I'll produce the migration checklist (1-pager) and include a sample nginx/ingress snippet + a small curl test for routing validation. ETA: Tue.
Ben: Legal will provide suggested clause for quant profile deprecation by Wed.
Sam: Action recap (compact):
- @Diego: thresholds for sentinel metrics + rollback policy (EOW)
- @Clare: hosted->dedicated migration checklist + sample snippets (Tue)
- @Ben: legal wording for quant deprecation (Wed)
I'll post a status update on Thurs. If you take anything else on, @mention me so I can update the owners list. Thanks! :rocket:
